installStep.name: Beautifully Overhauled and Objectively Better Icons Enhanced for SkyUI

plugin.name: Core Files
plugin.description:
Core files required to install B.O.O.B.I.E.S. On the next page, the installer will recognize any supported mods by looking for their active plugins in your list. It will not be able to identify any mods you may have merged so be sure to select those manually.
Keyword Item Distributor (KID) files will be installed for each selected mod to ensure they use the appropriate icons.

plugin.name: Only Files for AIT
plugin.description:
Only the files required to install Aura's Inventory Tweaks.
Only install this option if you are using Aura's Inventory Tweaks for SkyUI by GroundAura [https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/68557]. If you select this option please send all your questions to that mod page.
This will only install the icon files, everything else will be handled by AIT.
